schema.principle: Whole-job, per-visit line-item sheet (up to 5 room columns). Baseline of commonly billed mitigation labor. Companion to logs/scope_sheet_template.json (per-room object); line numbers here are the shared reference for crew procedures and photos.

meta.provenance: transcribed from a third-party industry mitigation scope sheet (rev 2017) as a baseline of commonly billed mitigation labor; company overlay pending review
meta.genericized: Source company name omitted; brand-name products replaced with generic terms (lines 2, 4).
meta.photo_rule: If it is on the sheet, photograph it. Ties to crew procedures 1.3 (proof photos) and 1.5 (daily scope sheet). Lines 101-103 are explicitly 'photo needed' on the source.
meta.cat3_flag_meaning: Source prints a shaded '3' in the column before the room columns on these lines; read as 'typically applies on Category 3 losses'. Not a rule that other lines never apply.
meta.highlighted_in_source: Lines 71, 72, 74b, 93, 94, 94a, 95-98 are highlighted yellow on the source (reason not stated; mostly hour-based or PPE items).
meta.relationship: logs/scope_sheet_template.json (schema 1.1) is the existing per-room keyed object (header + containment/extraction/flooring/... + equipment date-set array). This template does not replace it: it is the line-numbered whole-job sheet. Most of its fields map to lines here (e.g. containment.plastic_sf -> 5/14, zippers -> 16, flooring.* -> 25-48, cabinets.* -> 49-53, content_manipulation.hours -> 6, equipment[] -> 80-94a). The old one has items this one lacks (crown, appliance removal counts, R-value, date set/pulled per unit) and vice versa (PPE, QA checklist, manpower, Cat 3 flags). Merge later via NEXT.md, not silently.
meta.transcription_notice: TRANSCRIPTION, working draft. Transcribed from photos of a third-party mitigation scope sheet; may contain reading errors and needs cleanup. Use it to understand what a scope sheet covering most billable mitigation labor looks like, not as a finished company form.

qa_checklist.q: Was a sketch completed with accuracy within 1 inch, showing placement of equipment?
Were before and after pictures taken? Overviews? All equipment shown?
Did you take and include any thermal images?
Has the drying log been signed and submitted? Moisture map completed?
Were readings taken at sill plates? 3-inch screw test?
Did you get the customer signature on this form confirming work times?

manpower.note: HOURS PER DAY entered as ___ Techs ___ HRS; mark X if after-hours.

uncertain_lines.issue: Option codes LS and LF are not defined on the sheet.
uncertain_lines.best_guess: LS = lead sample/swab taken; LF = lead-free (or lead result filed); A = asbestos tested; N/A = not required. Confirm with source or replace with plain choices.

uncertain_lines.issue: Cat 3 marker sits between rows 69 and 70 because the photo is skewed.
uncertain_lines.best_guess: Row 70 (pressure wash / under sill plates / extract). The row is shaded like other Cat 3 rows and the text slope places the marker there. Row 69 (clean joists) not flagged.
Count marker (enter number of power boxes), not a Cat 3 flag. Treated cat3_flag=false.

uncertain_lines.issue: 'ETES' is an acronym, not spelled out.
uncertain_lines.best_guess: Electric thermal energy system (heat drying). Confirm.
